sentences.en: Being only a student, I can't afford to get married.
sentences.zh: 作为一名学生，我负担不起结婚。

sentences.en: He can afford the time to play the guitar though.
sentences.zh: 尽管他有时间弹吉他，但他还是可以负担得起。

sentences.en: It was a purchase which he could not possibly afford.
sentences.zh: 这是一次他根本买不起的购买行为。

mnemonic: 联想记忆：af+ford（看作Ford，美国福特家族）→财大气粗→担负得起
